# `pygeovision pipeline`

Run a **YAML workflow** (steps: search, download, infer, export) or list the templates. Authoring guide:
[YAML workflows](../../pipelines/yaml-workflows.md). (Not to be confused with `channel`, which runs the built-in pipelines.)

## When to use it

Use it to repeat the same search → download → inference chain on new places or dates.

## What you get

`--dry-run` checks the step graph and prints it without running anything; a real run reports each step and the outputs.

## Things to know

`--set STEP.PARAM=VALUE` overrides a parameter (parsed as JSON, else a string). Always `--dry-run` a new file first.

## Commands

```text
Usage: pygeovision pipeline [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Pipeline management — create, run, schedule workflows.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  list-templates  List available YAML pipeline templates.
  run             Run a YAML pipeline (steps: search, download, infer, export).
```

### `pygeovision pipeline list-templates`

```text
Usage: pygeovision pipeline list-templates [OPTIONS]

  List available YAML pipeline templates.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
```

### `pygeovision pipeline run`

```text
Usage: pygeovision pipeline run [OPTIONS] YAML_PATH

  Run a YAML pipeline (steps: search, download, infer, export).

  Example:
      pygeovision pipeline run urban.yaml --set search.bbox='[15.0,45.1,15.1,45.2]' \
          --set search.date_range='["2024-06-01","2024-06-30"]' --set infer.checkpoint=best.pth

Options:
  --dry-run               Check the step graph without running anything.
  --set STEP.PARAM=VALUE  Override a step parameter (value parsed as JSON, else a string);
                          repeatable.
  --help                  Show this message and exit.
```
